headline: Baby Who Made Hospital History Comes Home on First Birthday
meta_description: A baby who made hospital history for her exceptional size has finally been discharged on her first birthday, a milestone her family celebrates as miraculous.
summary_short: After making hospital history for her size, a baby girl has reached a milestone her family calls miraculous: coming home on her first birthday.
body:
A baby girl who made hospital history for her size has reached a milestone her family dreamed of: coming home on her first birthday.

The child's journey through medical care captured attention across the healthcare community, with her exceptional circumstances earning note in her hospital's records. Her parents, who refer to her as their "little miracle," marked the occasion as a turning point—from intensive medical care toward the next chapter of her life at home with her family.

The story reflects the resilience of both child and parents through an extraordinary medical experience. As she turns one, the family's journey from hospital milestone to home celebration represents hope realized.
quick_facts: Baby made hospital history for her unusual size
